content.text: The letter never mentions the comparison index. It reports the sleeve's own returns (1.94% net, 2.26% gross, 5.71% YTD, 9.38% since inception) but gives the reader no benchmark against which to judge them — the 2.12% Senior Secured Direct Lending Index figure is absent entirely, as is any reference to the index by name or to relative under/outperformance.

points.evidence: The letter's performance paragraph lists only the sleeve's own returns — "the sleeve returned 1.94% net of fees (2.26% gross of fees). Year to date, the return is 5.71% net of fees. Since the strategy's inception on April 1, 2023, the annualized return has been 9.38% net of fees." Neither the Senior Secured Direct Lending Index, its preliminary Q3 2026 return of 2.12%, nor any other comparison benchmark appears anywhere in the letter.
